scenery @8:look#0.name: SB radio
scenery @8:look#0.text:
Spacetruck
   This is a twelve-meter rig, the largest Class Three spacecraft made, with seats for a pilot and copilot. Below the viewport is a space band radio, a red button for activating the emergency beacon, plus a slot and keypad for controlling the autopilot. The hatch is open and the rear of the truck is empty of cargo.
   Floyd is here, also looking around the room.
   You can see a survival kit here.
 
>

scenery @8:examine sb radio#1.name: SB radio
scenery @8:examine sb radio#1.text:
The radio seems to be damaged, because the microphone is missing. It looks like the SB radio is off.
 
>

scenery @8:examine chronometer#7.text:

scenery @63:look#22.name: pulpit
scenery @63:look#22.text:
Chapel
   This is a modest, nondenominational chapel. Hanging high above the beautiful wooden pulpit are the two universal symbols of every major galactic religion: an eternal flame and a seven-pointed star. The flame flickers in the air currents. A doorway occupies the center of the east wall.
   The star is blinking.
   Plato and Floyd are both here.
   You can see a puce nanofilm spool here.
 
>

scenery @63:examine pulpit#23.name: pulpit
scenery @63:examine pulpit#23.text:

   Floyd gives Plato a friendly hug.
 
>

scenery @63:examine seven-pointed star#2.name: seven-pointed star
scenery @63:examine seven-pointed star#2.text:
It's blinking with a gentle, rhythmic light. The star is above you, beyond your reach.
   Plato reaches the last page of his book. "Heavens! It appears to be time for another jaunt to the library. Would you care to accompany me, my boisterous friend?"
   "Oh boy yessiree!" says Floyd, bounding off after Plato. "I hope they have copies of my favorite comic, THE ADVENTURES OF LANE MASTODON!"
 
>

scenery @63:examine eternal flame#27.text:
